Focused controls invoke the actual production launcher path, preserve exact private Runtime/source-root/Remotion/Node/PYTHONPATH/cwd bindings, preserve an unrelated variable, reach the body once, and return exit 17 unchanged.
Poisoned Agent SHA is rejected before the body; body invocation and body evidence files remain zero.
